pr_title: Fix "key count" setting showing as "circle size" in osu!mania editor
pr_comments: I also wouldn't go as far as to say that this closes the linked issue because the slider is still half broken (requires save and full editor reload to take effect).

issue_context.title: Select key count of a mania map in the lazer editor
issue_context.body:
Option to configure key count (to set 4k, 5k, 7k, for example) in the setup page for mania mode of osu!lazer edtior. Currently the lazer editor only support 5k mapping for mania mode (correct me if I am wrong).

Just in my opinion this is truely an important feature, to let mappers get the key count they want. I have searched the web to find if there is already a option doing this, ending up only found [the Reddit answer](https://www.reddit.com/r/osugame/comments/kagjoy/how_to_change_amount_of_keys_used_for_an_osumania/gfdurcw/) .
comments:
You *can* change the key count of a mania map by changing the "object size" setting then saving the beatmap and opening editor again.

However, the drawable ruleset should probably update on changes to that setting (which would later properly display as "key count"), so the user wouldn't have to exit and re-open.

Oh man I tried asking my pals and did some useless searching. Finally end up with the issue. Hope devs can see this and fix the problem. Two years have passed and the drawable ruleset hasn't been updated.
The "circle size" slider in mania editor has been renamed to match purpose. Mind you, the changes still will not apply until a full editor reload, but let's track that as part of #17127.

> The "circle size" slider in mania editor has been renamed to match purpose. Mind you, the changes still will not apply until a full editor reload, but let's track that as part of #17127.

I'm on the August 03 build and it still says "circle size". I'm using the Mac build though, so maybe it just wasn't changed there?
@ViRiXDreamcore change hasn't been deployed yet, please wait for next release. 2023.803.0 was a hotfix that did not include this.

review_comments: Not something to address in this pull, but the "fun" thing with this is that the base `DifficultySection` has localisable descriptions, but we can't actually do that in ruleset DLLs right now... Going to need tooling support.

This is fine and all, but if we're doing this, we should probably also hide the AR slider in mania, and both the CS and AR sliders in taiko, as they do absolutely nothing. And rename base velocity in taiko to scroll speed.

Also for some reason the key count slider still has 0.1 precision.

![osu_2023-07-21_20-36-11](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/20418176/a3f1d488-9736-4748-8473-cfc1452ba43c)
Yeah, I have a feeling there would be others, which is why I made the implementation allow full control. I'll fix the precision here, but the others should probably be added in a separate pull?
Sure, we can do the rest separately.
